info.name: Query Dashboard Query Dashboard API API
Trigger query audit search for a count using various filters.

params.name: integration_type
params.description: Integration type. Allowed values: 'snowflake', 'oltp', 'all'.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Resolution of the data. Allowed values: 'hour', 'day', 'month', 'year'.

params.name: from_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended before this time will not be counted. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Required with to_date_time.

params.name: to_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended after this time will not be counted. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Required with from_date_time.

params.name: consuming_users
params.description: OLTP consuming usernames. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: repository_users
params.description: OLTP repository usernames. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: consuming_user_emails
params.description: OLTP consuming user emails. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 1024 chars.

params.name: repository_types
params.description: OLTP repository types. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10.

params.name: repository_names
params.description: OLTP repository names. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: repository_sources
params.description: OLTP repository sources. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: statement_types
params.description: Statement types. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Allowed: SELECT, INSERT, DELETE, UPDATE. Max 10.

params.name: ip_addresses
params.description: IP addresses. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 45 chars.

params.name: snowflake_usernames
params.description: Snowflake usernames. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: snowflake_current_roles
params.description: Snowflake current roles. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 255 chars.

params.name: query_texts
params.description: Query texts. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 15000 chars.

params.name: snowflake_query_tag_values
params.description: Snowflake query tag values. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 512 chars.

params.name: snowflake_query_tag_names
params.description: Snowflake query tag names. Excluded with integration_type=oltp or all. Max 10, each max 256 chars.

params.name: tag_present
params.description: Filter to only include queries where a tag is present or absent. Allowed values: TAG_PRESENT, TAG_ABSENT.

params.name: connection_status
params.description: OLTP connection status. Excluded with integration_type=snowflake or all. Allowed: SUCCESS, FAILED, ALL.

params.name: group_by
params.description: Group by. Allowed: repository_name, repository_username, repository_type, repository_source, consuming_user, consuming_user_email, statement_type, query_text, ip_address, snowflake_current_role, snowflake_query_tag_name, snowflake_query_tag_value, snowflake_username.

params.name: count_by
params.description: Count by. Allowed: accessed_rows, query_count, snowflake_username, consuming_user, snowflake_current_role, repository_user.

items.docs:
This endpoint triggers a search to return DAM metrics based on the provided parameters.
The `search_uuid` that is returned expires after 30 days.

info.name: Get the results of a search using the `search_uuid`.

params.name: search_uuid
params.description: `search_uuid`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results returned. Default is 500.

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves the results of a search using the `search_uuid` provided by the /audits endpoint. The results are paginated and can be retrieved using the `next_page_token` provided in the response.
